title: Local mass is invariant under negation of a current
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P an arbitrary set, T₁, T₂ ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (SimonGMT GeometricCurrentOn U n) and W ⊆ ℝ^P an arbitrary set. If T₁(ω) = −T₂(ω) for every test form ω ∈ 𝒟^n(U) (TestFormOn U n), then M_W(T₁) = M_W(T₂). Here M_W(T) = T.massOn W ∈ [0, ∞] is the supremum of ENNReal.ofReal(T(ω)) over the admissible forms ω ∈ 𝒟^n(U), i.e. those with tsupport ω ⊆ W and |ω(x)| ≤ 1 for all x ∈ ℝ^P (massAdmissibleOn U n W, |·| the Euclidean covector norm covectorEuclideanNorm).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T₁ T₂ : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (W : Set (Euclid P)), (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, T₁ ω = -T₂ ω) → T₁.massOn W = T₂.massOn W
